title: Cute, but impractical
text:
Cute, but impractical. These are very cute! You get a good color assortment, so you can use them nearly anywhere.

But, we rent, so we are very limited on where or how we can use these. I have not tried one on a painted surface yet, as I don't want to peel paint off the wall.

The main downside to me, is that it really only holds one cord at a time. The one I currently have on my nightstand holds 5 cords...the little hands, just one.

So, very cute, but impractical.
